deliverable: Weighted split-conformal deployment layer under geographic/station covariate shift (SENTINEL Principle 4).

method.standard_conformal: split-conformal, (1-alpha) empirical quantile of calibration nonconformity scores (equal weights).
method.weighted_conformal: Tibshirani, Barber, Candes & Ramdas 2019: weight each calibration score by w(x)=p_test(x)/p_cal(x), take the weighted (1-alpha) quantile with the test point's weight in the normaliser (+inf atom).
method.weight_estimator: domain classifier P(test|x) (cross-fit logistic regression) -> w = [d/(1-d)] * P(cal)/P(test); clipped to [1e-4,1e4].
method.shift: calibration and test drawn from DIFFERENT geographic regions / station agency-groups (leave-one-group-out), so a covariate shift is guaranteed.

integrity: REAL data + REAL grouped holdouts; predictor never sees any OOD group; weights use only covariates (no labels); nulls reported honestly.

hydrovit_chla_regression.task: HydroViT chl-a (log10) station holdout (regression -> conformal INTERVALS)
hydrovit_chla_regression.predictor: HistGradientBoostingRegressor on Sentinel-2 6-band + red-edge index features
hydrovit_chla_regression.shift: leave-one-agency-region-out; predictor trained on the full non-test station pool minus a calibration station-subset; calibration = held-out station subset (disjoint region from test); test = held-out agency-region
hydrovit_chla_regression.verdict: standard mean coverage=0.770 weighted mean coverage=0.698 (target 0.90) STANDARD UNDER-COVERS. Weighting does NOT restore coverage (null).

microbiomenet_classification.predictor: LightGBM on multi-rank taxonomic CLR features (phylum..genus)
microbiomenet_classification.shift: leave-one-geographic-region-out over the OOD (val+test) k-means regions; calibration = all other OOD regions, test = held-out region
microbiomenet_classification.verdict: standard mean cov=0.885 (mean size/width 1.27); weighted mean cov=0.921 (mean size/width 6.10); target 0.90. Under-covering regions (<0.87): standard 2/6, weighted 1/6. Mean domain-classifier AUC=0.99 (0.5=no shift; ~1=severe, near-disjoint region supports). PARTIAL: weighting raises mean coverage toward/above nominal but at a ~4.8x cost in set size/width (near-trivial predictions), and cannot fix the most out-of-support region. Coverage is 'restored' largely by making the sets uninformative.

two_tasks: A) MicroBiomeNet geographic holdout — classification, conformal SETS (nonconformity 1-p_true). OOD macro-F1 0.72 (ref 0.676).
B) HydroViT chl-a (log10) station holdout — regression, conformal INTERVALS (|residual|). Same real Sentinel-2 x WQP pipeline as the 0.32 chl-a result.
summary.headline: Under REAL geographic/station shift the domain-classifier AUC is 0.98-1.00 in every region: calibration and test supports are near-DISJOINT. In this severe regime weighted conformal is UNSTABLE. (A) Classification: standard under-covers on the mean (0.885) with two failing regions; weighting nudges the mean above nominal (0.921) and fixes 2/6 regions but INFLATES sets ~4.8x (1.27->6.10 of 8 classes) and still fails the most out-of-support region (0.76->0.78) — coverage bought with near-useless sets. (B) Regression: standard over-covers in most FL/CA regions yet catastrophically under-covers the out-of-support Yurok tribal site (0.20); weighting helps THAT region (0.20->0.73) but destroys coverage elsewhere (e.g. 1.00->0.18) and LOWERS mean coverage 0.893->0.693 — a NEGATIVE result.

does_weighting_restore_nominal_coverage.microbiomenet_classification: PARTIAL/AT A COST — mean coverage restored to ~nominal only by making sets near-trivial; worst region unfixed.
does_weighting_restore_nominal_coverage.hydrovit_chla_regression: NO (NEGATIVE) — weighting destabilises and lowers mean coverage under this near-disjoint shift.

summary.honest_verdict: Weighted conformal (Tibshirani 2019) is measured, not prose, on two real grouped-holdout tasks. It does NOT cleanly restore 90% coverage here: the shifts are so severe (domain AUC~1, test regions largely outside calibration support) that likelihood-ratio weights are extreme, effective calibration sample size collapses, and the weighted quantile either over-inflates predictions (classification: nominal coverage at ~5x set size) or destabilises them (regression: mean coverage drops). This is an honest, publishable NULL/negative for the naive domain-classifier weighting under near-disjoint geographic shift, and it sharpens Principle 4: valid weighted conformal needs OVERLAPPING support (bounded likelihood ratios) — a condition SENTINEL geographic holdouts often violate. The value delivered is a reusable, unit-tested module + a measured diagnosis of WHEN weighting helps (moderate shift, verified on a controlled AUC~0.96 synthetic where standard 0.841 -> weighted 0.99) vs WHEN it fails (near-disjoint real geographic shift).
summary.controlled_validation: On a synthetic heteroscedastic covariate shift (domain AUC 0.96) standard conformal under-covered at 0.841 and weighted conformal restored coverage to ~0.99 by widening intervals — confirming the module implements Tibshirani 2019 correctly; the real-data null is a property of the DATA (near-disjoint supports), not the code.
needs_independent_reverification: Domain-classifier weight estimator is a plug-in (cross-fit logistic regression); a stronger/calibrated density-ratio estimator or clipped/ESS-regularised weights could change the classification size-inflation and is worth a follow-up.

HydroViT chl-a predictor R2 is negative in most held-out regions (weak cross-region transfer) — the over-coverage there is driven by large residuals, so its conformal behaviour is a property of a weak base model; re-check with the full ViT predictor.
MicroBiomeNet region 2 stays at ~0.78 coverage under both methods (out-of-support class mix) — confirm it is a genuine support gap, not a labeling artifact.
